competitor_advantages.point: Bite's patented 'Bite Lift' AI analyzes kiosk transactions to make real-time upsell recommendations, which the company says drive 20% higher check averages.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Bite is a kiosk-ordering software vendor for fast-casual/QSR chains (Portillo's, Big Chicken among named customers), with AI-driven upsell technology and $9M in Series A funding.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes directly on kitchen_drive_thru/self-order kiosk and, secondarily, on digital_menu_boards where kiosk ordering overlaps with menu presentation and upsell logic.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Bite was named to Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies list for 2025, raising its visibility in kiosk RFPs.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where a prospect is comparing kiosk vendors, expect Bite's named references (Portillo's, Big Chicken) and its 'Bite Lift' upsell AI to come up as differentiators.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: 20% check-average and other performance claims are vendor-reported; still a relatively small company (single $9M raise) relative to larger kiosk/POS incumbents.
